rows.grounds: compound describing appearance; padma-rāga = ruby, ābhā = luster

items.question: In which direction is the radiant ruby-lustered Suprabhā established?
premises: Suprabhā is characterized as very bright.
Her placement is specified as the western direction.
items.inference: The radiant ruby-lustered Suprabhā abides in the western direction.
items.plain_english: Suprabhā, very bright and ruby-lustered, is situated in the western direction.
